title: Private open space and balconies element objectives
text: O 4.4.1 Dwellings have good access to appropriately sized private open space that enhances residential amenity. O 4.4.2 Private open space is sited, oriented and designed to enhance liveability for residents. O 4.4.3 Private open space and balconies are integrated into the overall architectural form and detail of the building.
notes: Objectives the Acceptable Outcomes of this element fall back to; text cleaned of column interleaving.
